title: Home
content:
Welcome to Kepoli, a food blog for people who cook at home most nights and want it to feel a little easier and a lot more enjoyable. This is not a place for restaurant theatrics or hard-to-find ingredients. It is a place for real meals, honest writing, and recipes you can make again next week without a second thought.

Everything here is organized around three simple ideas. In Story, we slow down to write about the meals and memories that make cooking worth doing. In Recipes, you will find dishes we have actually cooked and tested, written with enough detail to explain the timing, texture, and small decisions that matter. In Tips, we share the practical notes on ingredients, prep, storage, and technique that quietly make you a better cook.

Whether you are looking for something to make tonight or a few minutes of good reading with your coffee, we are glad you are here. Pull up a chair, browse the latest posts below, and cook something you will want to make again.

title: About Kepoli
content:
Kepoli is a small, independent food blog for everyday home cooks. It was built around a simple belief: that cooking at home should be approachable, rewarding, and free of unnecessary fuss. You do not need professional training, specialty equipment, or a long list of hard-to-find ingredients to make food worth sitting down for. You need clear guidance and a few recipes you can trust.

The three pillars

Everything we publish falls into one of three categories. Story is where we slow down and write about the meals, memories, and small kitchen moments behind the food. These are short essays meant to be read with a cup of coffee. Recipes are the heart of the site: dishes written to be repeatable, with enough context to explain the timing, texture, and small decisions that shape the result. Tips are the practical notes that make everything else easier, covering ingredients, prep, storage, and technique.

Who Kepoli is for

This site is for the person who cooks on ordinary evenings, not only on special occasions. It is for beginners who want recipes that explain the why, and for experienced cooks who appreciate a clear, honest guide without the padding. If you have ever wanted a recipe that simply works and tells you what to expect along the way, you are in the right place.

How we work

We hold our recipes to a straightforward standard: they are tested in a real home kitchen, using the kind of tools and ingredients most people already have. When something needs a tweak to work reliably, we make it before we publish. We also revisit older posts and update them when we find a clearer or more accurate way to explain something.

Independent and reader-first

Kepoli is independent. Our recipes and recommendations reflect our own cooking and honest opinions, not the priorities of a sponsor. We do not publish paid recipes disguised as editorial content. If we ever mention a product or use advertising to help cover the cost of running the site, we keep it clearly separate from the writing you come here to read. Questions and ideas are always welcome at {{SITE_EMAIL}}.

Who writes Kepoli

Kepoli is written by Isalune Merovik, a home cook and writer. She also researches the site’s traditional home-remedy articles — documented honestly, for general interest, and never as medical advice (see our Medical Disclaimer). You can reach Isalune at {{WRITER_EMAIL}}, or the site at {{SITE_EMAIL}}.

title: About the Author
content:
Hi, I am Isalune Merovik, the cook and writer behind Kepoli. I am not a chef, and I have never worked in a professional kitchen. I am a home cook, which I have come to think is exactly the right qualification for writing the kind of recipes I share here: food that fits into a normal week, made with the tools and time most of us actually have.

My cooking started the way it does for a lot of people, out of necessity and a little curiosity. Over the years, curiosity won. I learned by making the same dishes over and over, paying attention to what changed the outcome, and slowly figuring out why some things worked and others did not. That habit of noticing is what I try to pass along in every recipe and guide on this site.

I write Kepoli because I love the moment a recipe finally clicks, when it stops being a set of instructions and becomes something you can make without thinking. My goal is to get you to that moment faster. I test the recipes I publish in my own kitchen, I explain the small decisions that make a difference, and I try to be honest about what to expect, including the parts that take practice.

When I am not cooking or writing, I am usually reading about food, wandering a market with no particular plan, or feeding whoever happens to be around. I believe good food does not have to be complicated, and that the best meals are often the simple ones made with a little care.

Alongside cooking, I research and write Kepoli’s traditional home-remedy articles — gathering their history and everyday uses, and weighing them honestly against the evidence. I am not a medical professional, so I document these for interest, never as medical advice (see the Medical Disclaimer).

I would genuinely love to hear from you, whether you have a question, made one of my recipes, or just want to say hello. You can reach me anytime at {{WRITER_EMAIL}}.

title: Contact
content:
Thank you for taking the time to reach out. Kepoli is a small, independent site, and hearing from the people who read and cook from it is one of the best parts of running it.

We would love to hear from you if you have a question about a recipe, feedback on something you made, or a correction we should know about. If a recipe did not turn out the way you expected, tell us. That kind of note often helps us make a guide clearer for the next person. You can reach us by email at {{SITE_EMAIL}}.

Kepoli is written and run by Isalune Merovik. For a question about a recipe, one of our home-remedy guides, or a correction, email the site at {{SITE_EMAIL}} — or reach Isalune directly at {{WRITER_EMAIL}}.

We read every message and do our best to reply, usually within a few business days. Because Kepoli is run by a small team, it can occasionally take a little longer during busy stretches, so thank you in advance for your patience.

A quick note on partnerships: to keep Kepoli independent and focused on our readers, we do not publish sponsored recipes, accept guest posts, or run paid content disguised as editorial. Pitches of this kind will not receive a reply. For anything else, though, please do get in touch. We are always glad to hear from a fellow home cook.

title: Privacy Policy
content:
Last updated: August 16, 2026

At Kepoli, we respect your privacy and want to be clear about how we handle information when you visit kepoli.com (the "Site"). This Privacy Policy explains what we collect, why we collect it, how it is used, and the choices you have. By using the Site, you agree to the practices described here.

Information we collect

We aim to collect as little personal information as possible. The information we do collect falls into a few categories:

  • Information you provide. When you email us or fill out a contact form, we receive your email address, your name if you share it, and the content of your message.
  • Analytics data. We collect anonymized or aggregated information about how visitors use the Site, such as which pages are viewed and how people arrive.
  • Log data. Like most websites, our servers automatically record standard technical information, including your IP address, browser type, device type, referring pages, and the date and time of your visit.
  • Cookies and similar technologies. We and our partners use cookies and comparable technologies to operate the Site, understand usage, and, where enabled, support advertising. See the sections below and our Cookie Policy for details.

How we use information

We use the information we collect to operate and improve Kepoli, to respond to messages you send us, to understand which content readers find helpful, to keep the Site secure and working properly, and to display advertising that helps fund the Site. We do not sell your personal information.

Cookies and web beacons

Cookies are small text files stored on your device that help a website function and remember certain information. Web beacons, also called pixel tags, are tiny graphics that help measure how content and ads are used. We use these technologies for essential Site functions, for analytics, and, where advertising is enabled, to help deliver and measure ads. You can control or delete cookies through your browser settings, though disabling some cookies may affect how the Site works.

Third-party advertising and Google AdSense

Kepoli may display advertising served by third-party vendors and ad networks, including Google. These partners use cookies and similar technologies to serve ads based on your prior visits to this Site and other websites.

Third-party vendors, including Google, use cookies to serve ads based on a user's prior visits to this and other websites. Google's use of advertising cookies enables it and its partners to serve ads to you based on your visits to Kepoli and other sites on the internet.

You may opt out of personalized advertising by visiting Google Ads Settings. You can also opt out of a third-party vendor's use of cookies for personalized advertising by visiting www.aboutads.info/choices and optout.networkadvertising.org.

For more information about how Google handles data, see Google's Privacy Policy and How Google uses information from sites or apps that use its services.

Analytics

We use analytics services to understand how visitors interact with the Site so we can improve our content. These services may set cookies and collect information such as pages visited, time on site, and general location derived from your IP address. This information is used in aggregate and helps us make Kepoli more useful.

Your privacy rights (GDPR and CCPA)

Depending on where you live, you may have rights over your personal information under laws such as the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) or the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA). These may include the right to access, correct, or delete the information we hold about you, the right to object to or restrict certain processing, and the right not to be discriminated against for exercising these rights. To make a request, contact us at {{SITE_EMAIL}} and we will respond as required by applicable law.

Children's privacy

Kepoli is a general-audience food blog and is not directed at children. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13, or under 16 where a higher age applies. If you believe a child has provided us with personal information, please contact us and we will take appropriate steps to remove it.

Consent

By using the Site, you consent to this Privacy Policy. Where required by law, we ask for your consent before non-essential cookies, analytics, or personalized advertising are used, and you can withdraw or change your choices at any time.

Changes to this policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time to reflect changes in our practices or for legal reasons. When we do, we will revise the "Last updated" date above. We encourage you to review this page periodically.

Contact

If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy or how your information is handled, please email us at {{SITE_EMAIL}}.

title: Cookie Policy
content:
This Cookie Policy explains how Kepoli uses cookies and similar technologies when you visit kepoli.com. It should be read alongside our Privacy Policy, which describes how we handle personal information more generally.

What cookies are

Cookies are small text files that a website stores on your device when you visit. They are widely used to make websites work, to remember your preferences, and to help site owners understand how their pages are used. Similar technologies, such as web beacons and pixels, serve related purposes. Cookies may be set by Kepoli directly, known as first-party cookies, or by third parties whose services we use, known as third-party cookies.

Types of cookies we use

  • Essential cookies. These are necessary for the Site to function properly, such as remembering your cookie preferences and keeping the Site secure. The Site cannot work correctly without them.
  • Analytics cookies. These help us understand how visitors use Kepoli, for example which pages are most popular and how people navigate the Site. We use this information in aggregate to improve our content.
  • Advertising cookies. Where advertising is enabled, these cookies help deliver ads, limit how often you see a given ad, and measure how well ads perform. Our advertising partners, including Google, may set cookies to serve ads based on your visits to this and other websites.

How to control cookies

You are in control of the cookies on your device. Most web browsers let you view, manage, block, and delete cookies through their settings. You can usually find these controls in the "Settings," "Preferences," or "Privacy" section of your browser. Please note that if you block or delete certain cookies, some parts of the Site may not work as intended. To opt out of personalized advertising specifically, you can also use the tools described in our Privacy Policy.

Consent

Where required by law, we ask for your consent before placing non-essential cookies, such as analytics and advertising cookies, on your device. You can change or withdraw your consent at any time through your browser settings or any cookie controls we provide on the Site.

Questions

If you have any questions about how Kepoli uses cookies, please email us at {{SITE_EMAIL}}.

title: Advertising & Consent
content:
Kepoli is a free, independent site, and advertising is one of the ways we cover the cost of running it. This page explains how advertising works here, who our partners are, and the choices you have over the ads you see. It works together with our Privacy Policy and Cookie Policy.

Why we show ads

Hosting, tools, and the time it takes to test recipes and write carefully all cost money. Displaying advertising lets us keep Kepoli free to read while remaining independent, so we never have to turn our recipes into paid promotions. We aim to keep ads reasonable and clearly separate from the content you come here for.

Our advertising partners

When advertising is active, ads may be served by third-party partners, including Google AdSense. These partners use cookies and similar technologies to deliver ads, measure their performance, and, in some cases, personalize what you see based on your prior visits to this and other websites.

Personalized and non-personalized ads

Ads can be either personalized or non-personalized. Personalized ads use cookies and browsing information to show ads that may be more relevant to your interests. Non-personalized ads are based on general factors such as the content of the page or your approximate location, rather than your past browsing behavior. Where required, we will only show personalized ads with your consent.

Your consent and choices

If you are in a region covered by laws such as the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), we ask for your consent before personalized advertising and non-essential cookies are used. You can change or withdraw your consent at any time. You can also manage advertising choices directly through Google Ads Settings, www.aboutads.info/choices, and optout.networkadvertising.org.

Learn more

For full details on the information we collect and how cookies are used, please see our Privacy Policy and Cookie Policy. If you have questions about advertising on Kepoli, email us at {{SITE_EMAIL}}.

title: Editorial Policy
content:
Kepoli publishes independent food writing: stories, recipes, and practical guides for home cooks. This Editorial Policy explains how our content is created, how we keep it trustworthy, and what you can expect from what you read here.

How we create content

Our recipes are developed and tested in an ordinary home kitchen before they are published, using the kind of equipment and ingredients most people already have. When a recipe needs adjusting to work reliably, we make those changes first, so that what you read is what actually worked for us. Our guides and tips are written to be practical and honest, drawing on real cooking experience rather than theory alone.

Accuracy and sourcing

We take accuracy seriously. When we reference facts about ingredients, food safety, or technique, we rely on reputable sources and aim to reflect the current understanding. Cooking is not an exact science, so we try to explain the reasoning behind our recommendations and to be upfront about where results can vary from kitchen to kitchen.

Independence

Kepoli is independent, and our opinions are our own. Our recipes and recommendations reflect our genuine experience, not the priorities of any advertiser or brand. We do not publish paid or sponsored content disguised as editorial. If we ever feature a product or partnership, or if a post contains affiliate links, we will disclose it clearly so you always know what you are reading.

Corrections

We want our content to be as clear and accurate as possible, and we update posts when we find a better or more precise way to explain something. If you spot an error, whether it is a typo, an unclear step, or a mistake in a recipe, please let us know by emailing {{SITE_EMAIL}}. We review every report and will correct confirmed errors promptly.

Your trust

Everything on Kepoli is written with the goal of earning and keeping your trust. If we ever fall short of that, we want to hear about it.
meta_description: How Kepoli creates content: recipes tested in a home kitchen, independent opinions, no hidden sponsored posts, careful sourcing, and clear corrections.

title: Disclaimer
content:
The information on Kepoli, including all recipes, stories, tips, and guides, is provided for general informational and educational purposes only. We share it in good faith to help you enjoy cooking at home, but you use it at your own discretion and risk.

Cooking and allergen safety

Food safety is your responsibility in your own kitchen. Always check ingredient labels for allergens, handle food safely, and cook items to safe internal temperatures. If you or anyone you are cooking for has a food allergy, intolerance, or other dietary restriction, please review every ingredient carefully before preparing or serving a dish. When in doubt, leave it out or choose a suitable alternative.

Results may vary

Cooking is not an exact science. Even when a recipe is followed closely, results can differ from one kitchen to another because of differences in ovens, cookware, ingredient brands, freshness, altitude, and personal technique. We test our recipes in a home kitchen, but we cannot guarantee that yours will turn out identically. Treat cooking times, temperatures, and quantities as helpful guidance, and use your own judgment as you go.

Not professional advice

Kepoli is a food blog, not a source of medical or nutritional advice. Nothing on this Site should be taken as a substitute for guidance from a qualified professional. Any nutritional information we provide is an estimate and may not be accurate for your specific ingredients or portions. If you have health concerns, dietary restrictions, or specific nutritional needs, please consult a doctor or registered dietitian.

Advertising and affiliate disclosure

Kepoli may display advertising and may include affiliate links, which means we could earn a small commission if you click a link and make a purchase, at no extra cost to you. This helps support the Site and never affects the honesty of our recipes or recommendations. For more detail, please see our Advertising & Consent and Privacy Policy pages.

Contact

If you have any questions about this disclaimer, please email us at {{SITE_EMAIL}}.

title: Medical Disclaimer
content:
Some articles on Kepoli describe traditional home and folk remedies. This content is provided for general information and educational purposes only. It gathers the history, common uses, and cautions of each remedy and is not medical advice, nor a substitute for professional diagnosis, treatment, or the guidance of a qualified healthcare provider.

Not a substitute for medical care

Never disregard professional medical advice, or delay seeking it, because of something you read here. Some remedies can cause irritation, allergic reactions, or interact with medications, and what is safe for one person may not be safe for another — especially for children, pregnant or nursing people, and anyone with a chronic condition.

Before you try a remedy

Consult a qualified healthcare professional first, patch-test anything applied to the skin, and stop immediately if you notice a reaction. Seek prompt medical care for severe, worsening, or persistent symptoms, or in any emergency.

No liability

Kepoli and its authors accept no liability for any loss or harm arising from the use of this information. By using this Site you agree to these terms.

Contact

If you have any questions about this medical disclaimer, please email us at {{SITE_EMAIL}}.
